title: Simultaneous Coverage for Calibrated Effect Tolerance Profiles with at Most Two Centers
banked_reason: Mathematically sound incremental package, but the primary connected non-padded K=2 rate frontier, growing-class nonemptiness, and any strict paired inferential gain remain open; paper_score_ceiling 5.2 is below the field threshold 7.4.
gap_reasons: The primary connected, non-padded K=2 rate frontier, growing-class nonemptiness, and any strict paired inferential gain remain open.
The fixed six-path switch and K=1 elbow do not establish a K=2 lower bound or gain.
The proposal's central connected, non-padded K=2 deliverable is not supplied.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved finite-sample simultaneous profile coverage with all tied witnesses retained, certified a genuine fixed six-vertex K=2 gradient switch, and strengthened the connected K=1 star converse to the saturated min{1, sqrt(log(m+1)/n)} rate. The field-level program collapsed at the missing growing connected non-padded K=2 family and its aligned lower frontier: neither a strictly shorter tie-valid paired interval nor an impossibility theorem against the coherent covariance projection was obtained. A future retry needs a new K=2 invariant and comparison theorem rather than another bounded repair of the present core.
tldr: The paired projection theorem gives finite-sample simultaneous coverage of the calibrated profile and retains every tied root, partition, and center witness. Exact enumeration on a six-vertex path establishes a genuine two-center gradient switch, with every attaining partition using two nonsingleton positive-diameter blocks. A connected star yields a pointwise one-center honest-width lower bound of order \(\min\{1,\sqrt{\log(m+1)/n}\}\), with saturation when \(\log m\) is of order \(n\). The existence and minimax rates of the specified growing two-center path subclasses, and any strict paired improvement over both same-sample baselines, are explicitly left open in \(\text{oeq:paired-k2-frontier}\).
gap: Exact equal-variance or supplied-partition results do not give inference for an unknown at-most-two-center tolerance profile. Generic simultaneous bands cover the profile but may retain nuisance uncertainty that cancels in its width; an exact six-path switch demonstrates genuine paired nonsmoothness but not a growing-class rate or gain.
fill: Establish nonempty growing connected non-padded K=2 classes with quantified common-cell margins, determine their minimax honest-length frontier, and either prove a finite-sample paired gain over both same-sample baselines or a checkable obstruction, while retaining every tied root/partition/center witness.
